# Prompt: Generate architecture.md

Using the approved requirements.md, produce architecture.md with:

1. A short system overview (1-2 paragraphs) describing the file-based pipeline (parse -> validate -> generate) and how it maps to FR/NFR IDs.
2. A component list: parser, validator, generator, cli, models, mapping each to the requirement IDs it satisfies.
3. A simple data-flow description (input story -> requirements.md -> generated artifacts) in text or an ASCII diagram.
4. Key design decisions and trade-offs, each linked to the NFR or FR that motivated it.
